# How many employees does Lumilens have?

Lumilens, Inc. has approximately188 total employees worldwide as ofMarch 2026, according to Revelio Labs workforce intelligence data.Lumilens’s total headcount has grown9760.8% from 2 employees in 2023 to 188 in 2026.

Data source: Revelio Labs•Coverage: Global workforce, 2023–2026•Published August 2026

## Is Lumilens hiring right now?

Yes, Lumilens isactively hiring. Lumilens had57 active job postings in 2026, a 200.0% increase from 2025— [see job openings & hiring trends](https://www.reveliolabs.com/companies/lumilens/employees#postings).

## About Lumilens’s Workforce

Lumilens, Inc. is an Electronics Manufacturing company that employs **188** people worldwide as of March 2026. It is the 7th-largest by headcount among its [peers](https://www.reveliolabs.com/companies/lumilens/employees#similar-companies). Founded in 2024, the company is headquartered in Belmont, California.

Lumilens's workforce has grown from 2023 to 2026, rising by **9,760.8%** and reaching **188** employees, with headcount up **15.9%** year over year in 2026. The geographic distribution shows a concentration in South Asia ( **61.1%**), followed by North America ( **18.1%**) and Southeast Asia ( **13.8%**).

Lumilens's groups are Engineering ( **44.1%**), Finance and Operations ( **34.9%**), and Sales and Marketing ( **21.0%**), with Finance and Operations growing the fastest at **50.3%**. The average salary is **$50,794,** while regional medians vary from **$186,000** in North America to **$19,000** in South Asia, and the overall pay declined **18.3%** year over year in 2026.

Lumilens's hiring activity is rising, with active postings up **200.0%** in 2026 to **57**, and new postings per month increasing from **0** in 2023 to **16** in 2026. The latest quarter, 2026 Q1, shows a notable acceleration in postings, reflecting the rapid growth in the workforce. Lumilens holds the 7th position by headcount among its nine [peers](https://www.reveliolabs.com/companies/lumilens/employees#similar-companies).
